title: Gloves of the Automaton

sources.title: Circuitry Interface
markers: | description = You are considered a [[construct]]. Your weapon {{Attack roll}}s have {{Advantage}}, and you have [[resistance]] to {{DamageType|Lightning}} damage.

summary: Gain +1 Strength saves. Activate Circuitry Interface to be treated as a Construct and improve attacks.

fields.Circuitry Interface: Bonus Action once per Short Rest. For 10 turns you are treated as a Construct, gain Advantage on weapon attack rolls, and have Lightning resistance.
fields.Base value: 290 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Construct interactions: Many healing spells, including Healing Word, cannot heal you during Circuitry Interface. The Construct status also lets you use Light of Creation without its risk of stunning the wielder.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
